_note: Hand-written reference IR for tests/variants/brief-r2.md + api-r2.json (our own generalisation test: SME/business lending, one facility, no notes). 'Already paid' closes as no_arrangement / payment_claimed (no paid outcome in the API). note_reasons are empty because the brief never uses add_note. stage_rules are left empty (free text, ignored by ir_diff).

opening.first_sentence: Hello, this is the automated assistant of Copperleaf Business Finance. This call is recorded.

questions.ask: Could you tell me the company's registration number?
And in which year was the company founded?

identity.failed_message: I'm sorry, I can't go further on this call. Please call us on the number in your facility agreement.
identity.refusal_explanation: These questions protect the company's account.

product_types.spoken: business overdraft on the account ending <account_last4>

debt_intro: I'm calling about arrears on <company_name>'s account.
product_sentence: The <spoken> has <past_due> in arrears and is <days_late> days in arrears.
first_ask_single: Can the company pay the arrears today?

recording.after_promise_sentence: A confirmation letter will be sent to the company's registered office.

fixed_sentences.deceased: I am very sorry to hear that.
fixed_sentences.robot: I am Copperleaf Business Finance's automated assistant.
fixed_sentences.scam: You can check this call by phoning the number in your facility agreement.
fixed_sentences.paid: Payments can take up to two business days to reach us.
fixed_sentences.farewell: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

unmapped_rules: After both security answers pass, before anything else, say: "Before we go on, please note that this call is about the company's account, not your personal finances."
Never call the director by their first name, even if they introduce themselves by it or ask you to.
Only the named director counts: another director, the company secretary, the accountant, a shareholder or an employee is a third party.
Never record more than the arrears amount; if the director offers more, say early settlement is arranged by the account team and offer the arrears amount (not a refusal).
Never mention court action, insolvency, a personal guarantee or the director's personal credit file.
"The company owes this, not me" is not a dispute or a refusal: agree the call is about the company's account and continue.
Say every amount in pounds and pence exactly as the tools return it; never round.
